Hello. I'll describe the route from here to there. I'm starting at the cross. Okay, I'm going to walk straight down from the cross. I'll pass the sandy shore on my left. Then I'll turn right. I'll walk past the crane bay, which is on my left. Keep going down until I hit the local residents on my right. Turn right now. I'll walk along the road past the wood, but don't go too far right, I mean the wood is on my left.
Follower

Okay, I'm walking down past the shore and then turn right. I see the bay on my left. I keep going until I see the people on the right. Then I turn right and walk along the road with the wood on my left.
Giver

Okay, keep walking forward along that road. Soon you'll reach the dead tree on your right, but don't stop there. Keep going straight until you hit the lagoon on your right. Now, when you reach the lagoon, turn left immediately. Walk along the new path. You'll come across a rockfall on your left side, so stay close to it. Keep going until you reach the pirate ship on your left. From there, walk straight toward the finish at the bottom.
Follower

Okay, I turned left at the lagoon. I'm walking along this new path now. I see the rockfall on my left, so I'm staying close to it. Keep going... oh, I see a gurgling brook on my right now, but I'm keeping the rockfall on the left. I'll keep walking until I hit the pirate ship on my left. Then I'll head straight down to the finish.
Giver

Hold on, you're following the wrong path. Don't go near that gurgling brook; I never told you to turn right at the forked stream. You missed that landmark entirely. Keep walking straight ahead past the wood and the dead tree. You need to stay on the path that goes to the lagoon on your right, not the brook.
Follower

Okay, I see the mistake now. I was heading toward the brook. I'll keep going straight past the wood and the dead tree. Now I see the rockfall on my left, so I'll stay close to that. I'm walking along the path until I find the pirate ship on my left. Then I'll head straight down to the finish.
